content: regenerator2000 (github.com/ricardoquesada/regenerator2000) is an actively maintained (2026), Rust-based, cross-platform interactive 6502 disassembler for Commodore 8-bit machines. Installs via 'cargo install regenerator2000' or build from source with cargo. Accepts PRG/CRT/D64/D71/D81/T64/VSF/6502bench inputs directly. Exports to ACME, 64tass, Kick Assembler, and ca65 source. Supports import/export of VICE label files and has an optional live VICE binary-monitor connection (separate protocol from this project's MCP tool surface) plus its own MCP server for AI-driven disassembly.
